records.statement: Yamaha's 2020 WR250F owner's service manual (BAK-28199-10) has an emission-control chart and a general maintenance/lubrication chart on odometer intervals (initial 600 mi (1000 km) or 1 month, then 1800 mi (3000 km)/3 months and 3000 mi (5000 km)/6 months, repeating from 4200 mi (7000 km) or 9 months; engine oil and oil filter at every interval, valve clearance at initial and 3000 mi), plus a competition-use table. For competition it schedules engine oil after break-in and every fifth race (or 1000 km), oil filter after break-in and every fifth race (or 1000 km), air filter clean after break-in and every race, valve clearance check after break-in and every third race (or 500 km), spark plug inspect/clean after break-in and every third race (or 500 km), fork oil after break-in and every fifth race (or 1000 km), and coolant replacement as required / every two years.

Retighten release cylinder bolts, master cylinder bolts and union bolts. (Check for tightening torques.)
Inspect housing, friction plate, clutch plate and spring.

schedule.item: Shift fork, shift drum, guide bar

schedule.routine: Adjust lever position and pedal position.
Retighten brake disc bolts, caliper bolts, master cylinder bolts and union bolts.

schedule.item: Front fork oil seal and dust seal

schedule.routine: Inspect air pressure, wheel run-out, tire wear and spoke looseness.

The manual prints three interval tables, all captured here with a 'table' field on each row: the US emission-control chart and general maintenance/lubrication chart (columns 'Initial' and 'Odometer readings'; TIP: from 4200 mi (7000 km) or 9 months, repeat the maintenance intervals starting from 1800 mi (3000 km) or 3 months), and the 'Maintenance intervals for competition use' table. Competition columns carry no hour values, only km in parentheses ('or 500 km', 'or 1000 km'). Calendar intervals printed across the columns are given in 'calendar'; in the competition table those rows also carry an as-required mark. dealer_item = asterisk (Yamaha dealer should perform). 2027 has a hydraulic clutch: clutch fluid level every 45 hours and clutch fluid replacement every 4 years appear in both the general chart and the competition table.
